modification: persistent public v1; last saved installation plus owner use

conditions.environment_source: Approximate owner report; no continuous environmental or camera-temperature logging
conditions.initial_state: Owner-described roughly cold: On to set up view, Off for a few minutes, then On to start
conditions.pixel_shift_controller: Separate native PXS path; ordinary SteadyShot On is not an SS-Off control for the complete run
conditions.time_origin: First exposure, not independently recorded power-on time
conditions.environment_extrapolation: Hotter conditions could change the result substantially or little; no direction, magnitude, RH dependence or universal warm-up time established

coordinates: Native RAW pixels; ordered dy,dx; down/right positive. Image-derived motion, not actuator telemetry.

shape_comparison.method: Existing measured coordinates; centered ideal-pattern RMS/max, plus similarity-only shape residual. No new image registration or physical test. Similarity removes translation/rotation/uniform scale but not shear or drift. Error is Euclidean native-pixel distance. Descriptive, not a calibrated error bar.
interpretation: Sixteen-shot centered ideal-pattern RMS/max increase across the two Shortest groups, 1 s and 5 s in this run; descriptive trend only, with chronological order and regional measurement spread as confounders.
Four-shot results are not monotonic: 2 s has lower ideal-pattern error than either Shortest; the 10 s group is mainly rotated and is the most square under a similarity-only fit.
Previous test_coef_1 sixteen-shot Shortest groups have lower worst-point error than its 1 s and 2 s groups; no uniform interval-to-error law established.

sixteen_drift_fit.method: Ordinary least squares on existing image-derived coordinates. Primary model: ideal positions + common translation + constant velocity versus actual capture timestamps. Secondary model also fits one affine grid. No per-frame free offset, high-order time fit or new registration.
sixteen_drift_fit.units: Euclidean native-pixel distance; dy down, dx right
limitations: Descriptive same-data fit, not independent validation of thermal or mechanical motion
Time/order and native target pattern are coupled; fitted drift may absorb sequence-dependent positioning errors
Registration regional spread remains; corrected coordinates do not establish image resolution or remove within-exposure blur

source_derivation.derivation: Existing measured coordinates and fits; explicit allowlist export with filenames, absolute timestamps, RAWs, photo previews, body identifiers and calibration omitted. No re-registration or camera access.

limitations: One body and one new chronological series; interval and elapsed operating state are confounded
Temperature and RH are approximate owner reports, not camera-temperature measurements or environmental validation
Ordinary shots use SteadyShot On; no separate stabilization-state measurement
Regional spread and method agreement are descriptive; shared measurement bias is possible
Same-sample regression is not independent verification of a physical drift model
Numeric data permit inspection of fits; RAW registration cannot be independently repeated from this photo-free export
advice: Shortest is a practical default for static ambient-lit scenes based on these and prior sixteen-shot observations, with four-shot exceptions; longer intervals may be needed for capture constraints. Your mileage may vary.
